question: What universal formula structure must be used when performing worship in all cases?
premises: Worship is to be performed everywhere.
The formula must begin with praṇava and end with namaḥ.
inference: In all cases, one should worship using a formula beginning with praṇava and ending with namaḥ.
plain_english: Everywhere one should worship with formulas beginning with praṇava and ending with namaḥ.
